criticalPolicy: Every required dimension for every critical scenario must pass.
nonGoals: Score general architecture eloquence or writing style.
Convert a size, density, prefix, or depth fact into an automatic split.
Treat raw model output as repository guidance or copy it into a skill.

automatedFacts: capability declaration and cold-navigation evidence validity
affected-code digest and computed structural triggers
agentJudgments: keep, split, move, or consolidate disposition

dimensions.pass: Recovers the capability owner, canonical entry, owner-to-result and failure paths, and mirrored tests from repository artifacts without using the tactical plan as a map.

Rejects automatic flattening and meaningless singleton nesting, grounding placement in a real domain, lifecycle, policy, translation, compatibility, protocol, runtime, side-effect, or ownership boundary.
Makes code, entries, tests, focused commands, and required navigation maps sufficient for cold navigation while treating the active plan as tactical evidence.
Chooses keep, split, move, or consolidate for current facts from separation of concerns, single responsibility, dependency direction, compatibility, and human navigation.
Uses size, density, prefix, cognitive-load, and depth findings as review facts rather than automatic split or folder instructions.
Requires a fresh plan-free probe to locate exact owner, entry, result and failure paths, mirrored tests, and focused command or map before accepting the structure.
Checkpoints structural triggers or navigation degradation, consolidates before further feature work when needed, and stops for human direction if the post-consolidation fresh probe fails.
Runs the canonical repository structure and style fact owners, leaves computed facts to automation, and visibly owns the architectural disposition and validation judgments.
